project_desc: Developed an AI-powered search engine that integrates real-time web search with LLMs to deliver grounded, source-cited answers.Integrated high-speed inference engines (Groq) and search APIs (Tavily) to deliver sub-second, web-grounded responses. Engineered prompt orchestration and follow-up suggestion logic to enhance conversation depth and AI accuracy.
